up: Return all activity records for compounds tested against the target 'Tyrosine-protein phosphatase non-receptor type 1' (ChEMBL ID: CHEMBL335). Filter for activity records where the standard_type is 'IC50'. For each record, provide the compound's ChEMBL ID, its canonical SMILES, the standard IC50 value (numeric), the standard units, the publication reference (PubMed ID if available, otherwise DOI), and the publication year.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_value AS ic50_value, a.standard_units, COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, d.year AS publication_year FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL335' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
